notes: Structured query template for the GSC Rank Tracker, built for the current TMR MCP. One connector: gsc (site URL account IDs). Field IDs are raw. Dates are NOT stored — the runtime resolves them from today's date: endDate = today - 3 days (GSC reporting lag), startDate = endDate - N calendar months where N is the user-chosen lookback (1, 3, or 6). Snapshot anchors are the 1st and 15th of every calendar month inside that window (twice-monthly sampling); each anchor's window runs from the anchor to the day before the next anchor, with the final window ending at endDate. One query is built per tracked keyword, each with a distinct title (Rank - <keyword>), and all of them are sent in a single connectors entry. The query filter is always an exact-match filter on the query dimension; the page filter is added ONLY when the user has voluntarily pinned a URL for that keyword. Country is an ISO-3166 alpha-3 code in reportParams.countries. Rows come back as [date, position, clicks, impressions] for days with impressions only; empty days are absent and become N/R. Per snapshot window the value is the impression-weighted average position: sum(position x impressions) / sum(impressions), rounded to 1 decimal. No currency (this report has no monetary metrics). Always validate_query before run_query.

queries.title: Rank history (one query per tracked keyword)

optional_filters.when: the user voluntarily pinned a page for this keyword (keyword | https://full/url) — never ask for this

queries.synthesis: Bucket rows into snapshot windows; per window compute the impression-weighted average position rounded to 1 decimal (empty window = N/R). Build a matrix of keywords (rows) x anchor dates (columns, newest to oldest). Per keyword: latest = most recent non-N/R value, previous = the non-N/R value immediately before it, change = previous - latest (positive = improved, because a lower position is better). Colour bands: <=10 green, 11-20 yellow, 21-50 orange, >50 red, N/R grey.
